Privacy & saved progress

This page describes the V230 website package, updated 20 October 2026.

Progress on your device

When you submit a quiz, the site stores your selected answers, the submission date and the content version in your browser’s local storage. It also remembers the last listening part you opened so you can return to it. This data is not sent to a LinguaNovels server and is not shared between devices.

Visitor statistics

LinguaNovels uses GoatCounter to measure page visits, referring websites and general browser, device and location statistics. Requests are sent to our separate linguanovels.goatcounter.com counter. Quiz answers and saved learning progress are not sent to GoatCounter. GoatCounter does not use cookies or browser storage for analytics. Its service processes connection information, including IP addresses, to count visits and estimate location; IP addresses are not stored in its database. See the GoatCounter privacy policy for details.

Accounts and storage

This website has no registration, contact form or active advertising scripts. It does not set application cookies. It uses local storage for progress and the last opened part.

Audio and hosting

The MP3 files were generated in advance. Playing an audio file does not send your text or answers to Google’s speech-generation service. When deployed on Cloudflare Pages, page and audio requests pass through Cloudflare, which may process connection information such as IP addresses and request logs under its own policies.

Future advertising

Advertising is not active in this version. Before adding advertising, the privacy information and any required consent controls must be updated.

Clear your progress

This removes only the LinguaNovels data stored by this website in this browser.
